newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill cuts China Light 1997 EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill cuts China Light 1997 EPS.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said it has cut its 1997 earnings per share (EPS) forecast for China Light and Power Co Ltd to HK$3.12 from HK$3.21 due to a reduction in capital expenditure.

In a November 5 report, Merrill Lynch said China Light's decision to cut its capital expenditure budget for 1997-99 to HK$16 billion from HK$18 billion "has significantly reduced the stock's earnings outlook".
Merrill said it would not rule out the possibility of a further capital expenditure cut in 1997 of up to HK$2 billion.
"With core earnings growth already languishing, we continue to recommend giving this stock a wide berth," it said.
Merrill has an intermediate reduce rating on the stock.

"We continue to expect CLP shares to underperform the Hang Seng Index (HSI) and the HSI utility sub-index. With core earnings expected to record compound growth of 6.8 percent (1996-2001), we would expect investors to continue shunning the counter in favour of growth stocks," it said.
